narrative.northStar: The Night Frame, the Day Page
narrative.overview:
Novus v2 is a photo frame that happens to run a media console. The home opens as one full-bleed photograph with a single caption on it: whatever is still running, at display size, with one press to resume. One snap down folds that same photo up into a band, and under it sits today's page: the date as a huge numeral, the month calendar, the seven service plates, and a row of file shortcuts. Left alone for the ambient delay (10 minutes by default), the frame drops its chrome and keeps only the photo, the clock, and the date.

Everything Novus draws itself is neutral, opaque, and still. The ground is a near-black ramp at night and a warm off-white by day; type is ink on ground or white over the photo. Colour arrives only from the photograph and from the official brand plates of the streaming services. Four semantic hues exist, and each has exactly one job. Depth comes from the photo and its scrim, not from glass or shadows; the only animated properties are transform and opacity, so the Surface Pro 4's HD 515 never has to repaint a blurred layer.

The system runs on two axes set on the `NvRoot` element: theme (`system`, `light`, `dark`) and posture (`tablet` for the hand at 30–50 cm, `tv` for the sofa at 1–2 m). Posture multiplies every type size and space by a scale and swaps touch targets to fixed larger values. Every v2 surface lives under `.nv-root`; the v1 screens that still exist (gallery, finder, viewer, video, streaming dock) are pulled into the same world by the bridge.
keyCharacteristics: One frame, then one page: a full-bleed photo with one caption, folding into a band over today's page.
No colour of its own: ink, ground, and a 9-step neutral ramp; four semantic hues with one job each.
Circle is a global action; rectangle is content and the actions that belong to it.
Opaque everywhere. The photo scrim is the only translucency, and it never becomes blur.
System faces only (Segoe UI Variable first, then locale CJK faces); no web fonts.
Two postures, one layout: sizes scale by 1 (tablet) or 1.25 (TV); targets are set per posture.

rules.name: The No Hue Of Its Own Rule
rules.body: Novus chrome never carries a hue. Icons inherit `currentColor`, the v1 "primary" is remapped to ink, and colour on screen comes only from the photo and the official service plates.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each semantic hue has exactly one job: live = a running session, attention = the user is needed, sun and sat = weekend dates on the calendar. A hue that appears anywhere else is a defect.

rules.name: The White Over Photo Rule
rules.body: Over a photograph, chrome is white (#ffffff, secondary at 78%) whatever the theme; the focus ring turns white there too.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a title. No kicker, no small uppercase category line: the caption starts with its display title, and section titles are plain headings.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Novus ships no web font. Every face is already on the device; the fallback chain exists so Korean, Japanese, and Chinese each get their own native face.

rules.name: The Posture Rule
rules.body: One layout serves both postures. Posture changes the scale (1 or 1.25) and the targets (48/56 or 64/72), and moves the rail within thumb reach in tablet posture; it never forks the composition.

rules.name: The Opaque Rule
rules.body: No `backdrop-filter`, no glass, no frosting. Material intensity (0–100) deepens the scrim; it never turns into blur.

rules.name: The Scrim-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only as scrims over a photo (and as the slider's fill). No decorative gradient on chrome.

rules.name: The Circle Means Global Rule
rules.body: A circle is an action reachable from anywhere (search, gallery, files, remote, settings, home). A rectangle is content, or an action that belongs to the content it sits on (이어서 보기, 세션 종료). If a control only acts on the thing beside it, it is a rectangle.

rules.name: The Focal Point Rule
rules.body: Every photo carries a vertical focal point (0 = top, 1 = bottom). The folded band shows that strip, and the bottom scrim stops below it. Bundled artwork records it explicitly (dawn-sea 0.58, misty-lake 0.55, ridges 0.5); user photos default to 0.5. Artwork made for Novus keeps its brightest point (the sun) inside that strip and draws it last so it stays the brightest value in the frame.

dos: Do build every v2 surface inside `NvRoot` and use only the role tokens (ground, surface, rule, text, focus), never raw ramp steps or hex.
Do make a control a circle only when it is a global action reachable from anywhere; everything else is a 4px rectangle.
Do order every photo caption as title, then state line, then one context line, then actions.
Do give every photo a vertical focal point and keep the scrim and the folded band honest to it.
Do author sizes for tablet posture and multiply by `--nv-scale`; set touch targets per posture (48/56px tablet, 64/72px TV).
Do animate only transform and opacity, with the press, move, and fold tokens, and honour reduced motion.
Do show the 4px ink focus ring (white on media), offset 3px, on every focusable element.
Do let service brands appear on their own ground with their official assets.
donts: Don't use `backdrop-filter`, blur, or glass anywhere; deepen the scrim instead.
Don't load web fonts; use the system face chain.
Don't add a decorative accent colour, tint, or gradient to Novus chrome; the four semantic hues keep their one job.
Don't put an eyebrow, kicker, or small category label above a title.
Don't give v2 components a box-shadow; depth comes from the photo and the plane order.
Don't make a content action round or a global action square.
Don't scrim over the photo's focal light; the sun keeps its value.
